fieldValues.title: D1. Arise: where decisions appear, and what we tried
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The ideal: a choice is noticed where it arises and named as a choice, not left in prose. What we have: decision language in PR bodies is caught by clerk pr-check (srs-decisions block); issues carry needs-input; conversations carry vignettes; sessions carry asks.
fieldValues.tensions: Notice every choice, and let small choices pass unrecorded.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which arising points produce choices that are never recorded? (count decision-stop findings here)
fieldValues.next_action: Record decision-stop findings at this stage as they are met.
